description: This PHP class 'EmployeeLanguageModel' is part of the OrangeHRM system, serving as a model for serializing and normalizing employee language data within the HRM API. It defines how an EmployeeLanguage entity is transformed into an API response, including language, fluency, competency, and comment properties.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageModel
classes.description: A model class used for serializing and normalizing employee language data for API responses, implementing the Normalizable interface and utilizing ModelTrait for common serialization functionality.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with an EmployeeLanguage entity, setting up filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
